reasons: Every element of the held Latin formula is represented: through our Lord Jesus Christ; your Son; who lives and reigns with you; unity of the Holy Spirit; God; duration through all ages of ages.
No same-Spirit word is introduced. The English preserves the Father as addressee and the Son as the relative-clause subject.
For all ages of ages is a close study rendering of the Latin duration, not a claim to a received English liturgical formula.
Amen remains a distinct response, as the primary historical source marks it.
